release-notes.what: Drafts release notes from the git commits since the last tag
release-notes.when: Use when the user asks for release notes, a changelog entry or what changed since the last release.
release-notes.not_for: Not for commit messages or pull request descriptions.
steps: Find the most recent tag with `git describe --tags --abbrev=0`.
List the commits since that tag with `git log <tag>..HEAD --oneline`.
Write a new section at the top of CHANGELOG.md, headed with the version and today's date, one line per change.
release-notes.done_when: CHANGELOG.md has one new section for the version; no other file changed; nothing committed, tagged or pushed

api-docs.what: Generates reference documentation for the functions a module exports
api-docs.when: Use when the user asks to document the API or update the API reference.
api-docs.not_for: Not for the README or comments inside source files.
steps: Find the exported functions in src/ with `grep -n "^export function" -r src`.
Read each one's parameters and return value.
Write docs/API.md: one section per exported function, with its signature and one sentence on what it does.
Check that every exported function has a section.
api-docs.done_when: docs/API.md has one section per exported function; no other file changed; nothing committed, tagged or pushed
